+        """Drive behind a log and push it in a straight line toward a neighbor."""
+        if s.episode_done:
+            return
+        lp, _ = pose(p, log)
+        tp, _ = pose(p, target)
+        delta = tp[:2] - lp[:2]

+        if distance <= threshold:
+            print(log, "already close to", target, distance, flush=True)
+            return

+        yaw = math.atan2(float(direction[1]), float(direction[0]))
+        # The R1 base is about 0.6 m wide; start one meter behind the log center.

+        p["move_base"](float(staging[0]), float(staging[1]), yaw,

+        tp, _ = pose(p, target)
